mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wf_form_schema (id, schema_name, schema_key, schema_version, json_schema, ui_schema, fields_config, applicable_orgs, status, created_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{schemaName}, #{schemaKey}, #{schemaVersion}, #{jsonSchema}, #{uiSchema}, #{fieldsConfig}, #{applicableOrgs}, #{status}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM wf_form_schema WHERE schema_key = #{key} AND status = 1 ORDER BY schema_version DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM wf_form_schema WHERE 1=1 AND status = #{status} AND schema_key LIKE CONCAT('%', #{schemaKey}, '%') ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE wf_form_schema SET schema_name = #{schema.schemaName}, json_schema = #{schema.jsonSchema}, ui_schema = #{schema.uiSchema}, fields_config = #{schema.fieldsConfig}, status = #{schema.status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
